title.value: The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These Seiran

value.originalTitle: 銀河英雄伝説 Die Neue These 星乱 第一章

overview.value: In humanity's distant future, two interstellar states-the monarchic Galactic Empire and the democratic Free Planets Alliance-are embroiled in a never-ending war. The story focuses on the exploits of rivals Reinhard von Müsel and Yang Wen Li as they rise to power and fame in the Galactic Empire and the Free Planets Alliance.
